long_biography.plain_text:
The Good Guys grew from six stores in 1987 into a national electrical-appliance retailer after Andrew Muir joined the family company. He helped choose expansion over remaining a small regional chain. He unified its various trading names and introduced a joint-venture model under which local proprietors shared each store's results with the Muir family company.

Muir also used the retailer as a platform for structured community giving. He established The Good Foundation in 2010 to promote nutrition and practical cooking skills, bringing Jamie Oliver's Ministry of Food programme to Australia. The foundation developed community cooking centres, a mobile kitchen and school-based food education, extending his work beyond the business he had helped build.
